newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian government raises domestic airfares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian government raises domestic airfares.

text.p: The Indonesian government has raised airfares for domestic flights by up to four percent, a transport ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
"This is an automatic adjustment due to the appreciation of the dollar," spokesman Handoyo said.
On Thursday, the dollar was trading at 2,320 rupiah in the foreign exchange market compared to a rate of 2,282 in early January.

The price rises for economy class domestic flights are based on costs per kilometre and depend on the overall distance of the flight, Handoyo said. For example, a flight under 600 km now costs 285 rupiah/km, a price rise of 3.6 percent.
Price rises varied between 1.7 percent and four percent. The government last ordered a price rise in April this year, raising airfares by 15-20 percent.
